Waffe.et: From Middle High German wāfen, from Old High German wāfan (compare Yiddish וואָפֿן (vofn)), from Proto-West Germanic *wāpn, from Proto-Germanic *wēpną. Cognate with Dutch wapen, English weapon, Danish våben, Swedish vapen, Gothic 𐍅𐌴𐍀𐌽 (wēpn). Doublet of Wappen…

s: ceasefire, truce (agreed temporary cessation of combat)
Waffenstillstand.et: From Waffen (“weapon”) + Stillstand (“standstill”), a calque of French armistice. Compare Dutch wapenstilstand.

Waffel.et: Borrowed from Middle Dutch wafel. Cognate with Dutch wafel, English waffle and English wafer, Swedish våffla, Icelandic vafla.

s: ceasefire, truce (agreed temporary cessation of combat)
weaponsmith, armourer (male or of unspecified gender)
Waffenschmied.et: From Waffe + -n- + Schmied. Compare English weaponsmith, Swedish vapensmed.
